joel: FYI caught a delayed-ingest window affecting meter events between 2026-04-05T11:30Z and 2026-04-05T13:45Z. ~95 customers show lower token counts on interim invoices. looks like late-arriving batches were dropped by the reconcile job. need remediation + customer outreach.
priya: initial triage: S3 uploader retried during a transient auth error and the reconcile worker timed out on a few partition reads; missing messages were not reprocessed. suspect bug in the checkpointing logic.
carla: finance impact: these customers were invoiced with <actual usage>. we'll need to either (A) post adjusted invoices after reconciliation or (B) issue top-up invoices. prefer adjustments + clear comms. will draft comm template if we have final corrected numbers.
finance-bot: Created FIN-5019: "Delayed-metering ingest -> invoice adjustments" (owners: carla, priya, joel). Severity: High. Linked to INC-2026-0405.
infra-runner: containment: paused the reconcile job at 12:10Z and queued a reparsing job for the S3 batch. added temporary alert on reconcile-errors > 5/min. rolling a fix for checkpoint race to canary later.
joel: proposed actions: 1) Stop/lock current reconcile (done). 2) Repair and re-run ingest for the window (owner: infra-runner) due: 2026-04-06T02:00Z. 3) Generate reconciliation report CSV for finance (owner: carla) due: 2026-04-06T04:00Z. 4) Draft customer comms + provisional note for billing (owner: carla) due: 2026-04-06T06:00Z. 5) Hotfix checkpointing + canary (owner: priya) due: 2026-04-06T10:00Z. 6) Postmortem & recurrence playbook (owner: joel) due: 2026-04-09. please ack or reassign.
priya: ack. hotfix plan: add durable commit on processed-offsets, add retry-on-read to reconciler, unit test for S3 read failures. canary in us-central-1 2026-04-06T08:00Z then global if green.
infra-runner: repair run started in dry mode: command: ```./reconcile --repair --start 2026-04-05T11:30Z --end 2026-04-05T13:45Z --dry-run --out repair-dryrun-0405.log``` dry run shows 93 affected cust_ids; will flip to write-mode after validation.
carla: finance note: once CSV arrives include columns (customer_id, invoice_id, original_tokens, recovered_tokens, net_delta, action). I'll queue adjustment batch after confirm. provisional policy: hold invoice adjustments while provisional notes sent, unless net_delta > $1000 then fast-track.
ops-oncall: monitoring: added metric `reconciler.checkpoint_delay` and alert `reconciler:checkpoint_delay > 60s for 3m`. also added a dashboard tile for `s3.uploader.retry_rate`.
joel: recurrence analysis: looks similar to past Mar incident but different root cause (S3 auth transient). add to incidents index and set recurring-pattern flag. propose automated retry + dead-letter for unrecoverable batches.
priya: QA: please run integration tests that simulate S3 errors and ensure reconciler replays. tagging qa-metering.
carla: comms draft: "We identified an ingestion delay that temporarily under-reported usage on invoices dated Apr 5. We are reconciling and will issue adjusted invoices where needed. No action required from customers at this time. Expected completion: Apr 6." will post to FIN-5019 for review.
joel: closing notes: owners accepted. I'll own the postmortem writeup and the recurrence checklist. update FIN-5019 as tasks progress. thanks all :white_check_mark:
